output.summary: An annual flowering crop reported as native from the eastern Mediterranean to India, common flax is known only as a cultivated plant. Its slender stems yield smooth, strong fibres used for linen, while its seeds are eaten or processed into edible flaxseed oil.
output.edibilityNote: Seeds are eaten or ground into meal; flaxseed oil is edible, though solvent-processed oil has also long been used for painting and varnishing.
